What is the exact registered name of the payments service? Once I have it, I'll roll it back to its last healthy release and open a SEV2 incident.

args.title: Payments errors following v3.4.0 deploy; rolled back to v3.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Identified the service**: The literal "payments" name wasn't registered; after checking variants, you confirmed it's **payments-worker** (the API errors were downstream).
- **Diagnosed**: v3.4.0 (this morning's deploy) was unhealthy in all regions with an 18% error rate; v3.3.0 was the last healthy release.
- **Rolled back**: payments-worker → **v3.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Status verified: healthy again, error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident opened**: **INC-0001** (SEV2, on-call paged) documenting the failed v3.4.0 deploy and the rollback, with a note to investigate root cause before re-deploying.
